newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher as banks surge.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher as banks surge.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended higher on Friday, outstripping gains on other European bourses after strong gains in banks, dealers said.
The general index rose 3.11 points, 0.65 percent, to 480.66 and the Ibex added 41.07 points, 0.75 percent, to 5,499.27.
Telefonica rose 55 pesetas to 3,400 on the last day of the retail share offer in the current privatisation.
Banks rose strongly, boosted by their own brokerages ahead of shareholder meetings, dealers said.
BCH gained 85 pesetas to 3,895, Santander climbed 240 pesetas to 9,470 and BBV added 90 pesetas to 8,840.
The decision to leave interest rates unchanged at 6.00 percent at this morning's Bank of Spain repo auction was largely anticipated by the market and had no effect, dealers said.
They saw no change in the bourse tendency short-term, adding that a climate of caution was still overhanging the market.
